enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain motionless. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Breathe. Turn on back. Breathe. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out pan and place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Pour coffee. Eat breakfast and drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing a cold lunch and water bottle, filling a thermos for the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out lunch container, water bottle, thermos. Open lunch container. Place food into container. Close container. Fill water bottle. Fill thermos. Close thermos. Place items into bag. Close bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus at hospital stop. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist, assessing and treating patients on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Enter ward. Greet patient. Review patient chart. Assess patient mobility. Assist patient to stand. Guide patient through exercises. Take notes. Move to next patient. Repeat assessment. Adjust equipment. Clean hands. Document treatment. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient progress. Update records. Prepare for next session.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating the packed lunch in a cool room
enriched_activities.desc: Go to break room. Sit at table. Open lunch container. Eat lunch. Open water bottle. Drink water. Close water bottle. Close lunch container. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Stand up. Return to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing physiotherapy sessions, exercise programs and patient documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Enter treatment room. Set up exercise equipment. Greet patient. Guide patient through exercises. Monitor patient form. Provide feedback. Adjust resistance. Record patient progress. Clean equipment. Move to next patient. Repeat. Write patient notes. Consult with colleague. Update patient files. Prepare discharge summary. Attend to patient call. Assist patient with walking.

Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit down. Fan self with hand. Wipe sweat. Get off bus. Walk to home. Open door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door. Remove shoes. Place bag down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a simple dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing and stacking dishes, wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Apply soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counters. Wipe table. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on light clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with a fan and dehumidifier running, avoiding air-conditioner use during the evening peak tax window
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on fan. Turn on dehumidifier. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Adjust fan speed. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Pour water. Return to living room. Sit down. Watch TV. Check phone. Adjust dehumidifier. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing patient notes and reading physiotherapy articles on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open patient notes. Read notes. Type notes. Open web browser. Search for physiotherapy articles. Read article. Take notes. Highlight text. Close browser. Open patient notes again. Review. Save file. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with light reading, turning on the air-conditioner briefly to cool the room after the peak tax window
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on air-conditioner. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Read book. Turn page. Read. Turn off air-conditioner. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Lie down. Pull blanket.
Lie down. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to other side. Stretch. Breathe. Turn on back. Breathe. Continue sleeping.
